# Third-party assets and tools

Every asset pack, font, sound, model or tool that is not made by the team is listed here
with its licence. This file is a deliverable of the project (proposal §3.1 b: "licensed /
Creative-Commons art and audio asset packs, clearly attributed").

Rules:
- Nothing goes under `Assets/ThirdParty/` without a row in this table.
- Files under `Assets/ThirdParty/` are never edited; put modified copies under `Assets/_Project/`.
- Check the licence allows redistribution in a compiled build (CC0, CC-BY, MIT, Unity Asset Store EULA are fine; CC-NC and CC-ND need discussion).
